Gold.note: Central bank buying and rate cut expectations support upside.

Silver.note: Weak industrial demand and recent underperformance versus gold weigh on outlook.

Copper.note: Tight concentrates market and energy transition demand offset weak Chinese property sector.

Uranium.note: Structural supply deficit and renewed global nuclear capacity additions drive bullishness.

Lithium.note: Persistent oversupply and slowing EV demand growth pressure margins.

Nickel.note: Surging Indonesian supply and sluggish stainless steel demand create a bearish outlook.

Zinc.note: Mine closures and tight treatment charges support a bullish price outlook.

Iron Ore.note: Weak Chinese steel margins and ample seaborne supply limit upside potential.

Coal.note: Ample global supply and long-term energy transition headwinds cap upside.

Rare Earths.note: Weak EV motor demand and abundant Chinese supply keep prices depressed.

Manganese.note: Sluggish global steel production limits demand growth for manganese alloys.

PGM.note: Substitution effects and weak auto catalyst demand offset hydrogen potential.

Potash.note: Stable agricultural application rates and normalizing global supply balance the market.

Aluminum.note: Tight primary supply from Chinese smelter curtailments supports structural deficit.

Diversified.note: Balanced exposure to base and precious metals provides a neutral macro hedge.
